video_title: Domantas Sabonis discusses his low FGAs, health, the Kings' 1-10 start, adding Mason Plumlee

quotes.speaker: Domantas Sabonis
quotes.summary_phrase: Domantas Sabonis confirms he is 100% healthy after recent struggles
quotes.excerpt: I feel great, I'm 100%. I feel amazing.
quotes.quote: I feel great, I'm 100%. I feel amazing. Last game was just a different game and I got to be better in the last.
quotes.social_post: Domantas Sabonis says he is 100 percent healthy after recent struggles. He admits he needs to be better in the final minutes of games.

quotes.speaker: Domantas Sabonis
quotes.summary_phrase: Sabonis addresses the team's poor start and need for improvement
quotes.excerpt: I feel like there were a lot of good things, there were some things that could have been better.
quotes.quote: I feel like there were a lot of good things, there were some things that could have been better. That's just how the game of basketball goes sometimes and there's nothing I can do just watch film, practice, work on my game and get better.
quotes.social_post: Domantas Sabonis on the Kings early struggles: There is nothing I can do but watch film, practice, work on my game and get better.

quotes.speaker: Domantas Sabonis
quotes.summary_phrase: Sabonis on navigating his role and team expectations
quotes.excerpt: We have great coaches, we have front office. I get to speak to them.
quotes.quote: We have great coaches, we have front office. I get to speak to them and understand what is it that is required for me and I'm going to go out there and play the best basketball I can.
quotes.social_post: Domantas Sabonis says he is in constant communication with the Kings coaching staff and front office to understand what is required of him to play his best basketball.

quotes.speaker: Domantas Sabonis
quotes.summary_phrase: Sabonis on the frustration of the Kings' 1-10 start
quotes.excerpt: None of us want to be here in terms of losing one in ten.
quotes.quote: None of us want to be here in terms of losing one in ten and seeing this team lose sucks. It hurts me. You want to bring it back and play good basketball and I feel like we are. We just got to put 48 minutes together.
quotes.social_post: Domantas Sabonis on the Kings 1-10 start: None of us want to be here. Seeing this team lose sucks. It hurts me.

quotes.speaker: Domantas Sabonis
quotes.summary_phrase: Sabonis welcomes the addition of veteran Mason Plumlee
quotes.excerpt: The more vets I feel like better. We have a really young team apart from Zack, me, Dre.
quotes.quote: I'm great. The more vets I feel like better. We have a really young team apart from Zack, me, Dre. So the more veteran leadership is good for these young players.
quotes.social_post: Domantas Sabonis welcomes the addition of Mason Plumlee to the Kings roster, saying the team needs more veteran leadership to help the younger players.

quotes.speaker: Domantas Sabonis
quotes.summary_phrase: Sabonis on his role and being aggressive offensively
quotes.excerpt: I just got to go out there and be aggressive.
quotes.quote: I just got to go out there and be aggressive. The game was played a certain way in terms of Magic playing defensively, taking away the role from me. That's where I'm effective. I felt like I could help the team out in other ways, getting D open on screens, assisting, rebounding and all that stuff.
quotes.social_post: Domantas Sabonis explains his offensive approach against the Magic, noting that when teams take away his role, he focuses on getting teammates open, assisting and rebounding.
